metadata.title: Gritty Urban Monochromatic Portrait with Metallic Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, monochromatic green portrait featuring a central subject overlaid with heavy, beveled metallic display typography framed by horizontal bars.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast portrait of a male figure in a dark jacket, rendered in a desaturated green duotone. The composition is dominated by a large, centered metallic wordmark with a 3D beveled effect, enclosed between two thin horizontal chrome-like bars.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed at viewer through a green color filter
Heavy metallic typography bisecting the lower third of the frame
High contrast between deep shadows and bright green highlights
Horizontal framing bars containing the central text element
coreInvariants: Monochromatic green color grading across the entire image
Chrome-effect beveled typography with a distinct 3D appearance
Horizontal parallel bars framing the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait, head and shoulders, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic, beveled text centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the cigar/hand, and rests on the bold metallic text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with the subject and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green shadows and midtones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale mint green highlights on the face and hands.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/chrome metallic sheen on the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high contrast duotone effect.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard heavy sans-serif forms used for metallic treatment
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant typeface with geometric graphic bars.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky structure.
Offers the compressed, heavy urban look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, gritty close-up portrait of a man in a jacket, applied with a monochromatic deep green duotone filter and heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single word in extra-bold, all-caps sans-serif centered in the lower third. Apply a 3D metallic bevel effect with silver gradients. Place two thin horizontal chrome bars above and below the text.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic green?
Does the text have a clear 3D metallic bevel?
Are there horizontal bars framing the text?
Is the portrait high-contrast and gritty?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the subject
Ensure the text content is generic or user-specified
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is centered and legible
Confirm presence of horizontal framing bars
recipe.reuseFormula: Gritty Portrait + Green Duotone + Metallic Beveled Type + Horizontal Bars
